summary: First-finish smoke test of SonicCheck MVP. Backend (regions/plans/auth/scans/quota/checkout) and core frontend flows (landing, register, login, pricing, protected-route, logout) all work. Two missing data-testids on Dashboard and one backend validation gap discovered.
passed: GET /api/regions returns 8 regions with correct codes (US,EU,UK,CA,AU,JP,IN,BR) and thresholds
GET /api/plans returns 3 plans (artist_pro $19, producer_pro $49, student $8) with features
POST /api/auth/register creates user, sets httpOnly cookies, returns user JSON (200)
POST /api/auth/login with admin@soniccheck.io / Admin@Sonic2026 succeeds (200) and persists via /api/auth/me
GET /api/auth/me without cookies returns 401 (unauth protection works)
POST /api/scans creates scan with deterministic result for free user
Free quota enforced: 4th scan attempt returns 402 with 'Free quota reached — upgrade to continue scanning'
POST /api/checkout/session with plan_id+origin_url returns valid Stripe checkout URL (cs_test_...) — payment NOT completed
Landing page (/) loads with hero 'Settle it before the lawsuit', SonicCheck branding, pricing/how-it-works/jurisdictions nav
Register UI flow → redirects to /dashboard, dashboard shows 'Welcome, QA', FREE TIER badge, 'New scan' button
Admin login UI flow → redirects to /dashboard successfully
Protected route guard: visiting /dashboard while logged out redirects to /login

failed.issue: Missing data-testid='dashboard-empty-state' on Dashboard empty-state element. Count=0 found on freshly-registered user dashboard where 'Recent scans' panel shows empty.
failed.evidence: page.locator('[data-testid="dashboard-empty-state"]').count() == 0 even though UI shows 'Recent scans' panel with no items

failed.issue: Missing data-testid='dashboard-region-selector' on the visible region selector dropdown next to FREE TIER badge / New scan button.
failed.evidence: Selector visible in UI (see screenshot) but page.locator('[data-testid="dashboard-region-selector"]').count() == 0

failed.issue: Backend accepts scan submission with empty lyrics AND no audio file — returns 200 with verdict CLEAR. Spec says 'Cannot submit scan without lyrics OR audio'. Backend should return 400/422. Frontend may guard via toast, but server-side validation is missing.
failed.evidence: curl POST /api/scans with body {"title":"Empty","region":"US"} → HTTP 200, counted against quota

action_items: Add data-testid='dashboard-empty-state' to Dashboard empty-state JSX (when scans.length === 0)
Add data-testid='dashboard-region-selector' to the region <Select> trigger on Dashboard
Add server-side validation in POST /api/scans: reject with 400 if both lyrics is empty/whitespace AND no audio file provided
